title.original: MegaFlow: Large-Scale Distributed Orchestration System for the Agentic Era
title.zh: MegaFlow：智能体时代的大规模分布式编排系统
title.en: MegaFlow: Large-Scale Distributed Orchestration System for the Agentic Era

inclusion_reason.zh: MegaFlow 以统一接口解耦模型、Agent 和环境服务，为数万级训练/评测任务提供可独立扩缩的分布式编排基础。
inclusion_reason.en: MegaFlow decouples Model, Agent, and Environment Services behind common interfaces, providing independently scalable orchestration for large training and evaluation fleets.

abstract.zh: MegaFlow 是面向 Agent 训练与评测的大规模分布式编排系统，把基础设施拆分为模型服务、Agent 服务和环境服务，并以统一接口连接。三个服务可独立扩缩和分配资源，以协调软件工程、计算机使用等复杂 Agent—环境交互。
abstract.en: MegaFlow is a distributed orchestration system for large-scale agent training and evaluation. It separates infrastructure into Model, Agent, and Environment Services connected by common interfaces so each can scale and receive resources independently for complex agent–environment workloads.

problem.zh: 复杂 Agent 训练不仅需要高吞吐模型推理，还要协调大量有状态环境和细粒度任务；现有开源设施无法在大规模下独立调度这些异构资源。
problem.en: Complex agent training requires both model throughput and coordination of many stateful environments and fine-grained tasks, which existing open infrastructure cannot schedule independently at scale.

approach.zh: MegaFlow 以三服务解耦模型计算、Agent 逻辑与环境执行，通过统一任务接口和分布式调度器分别分配资源、扩缩实例并跟踪交互生命周期。
approach.en: MegaFlow decouples model compute, agent logic, and environment execution into three services, with common task interfaces and distributed scheduling for allocation, scaling, and interaction lifecycle management.

system_design.zh: 模型服务批量承载推理，Agent 服务维护策略和轨迹，环境服务管理沙箱状态；中央编排面按任务阶段连接三者，并支持细粒度并发、故障隔离和异构配置。
system_design.en: Model Services batch inference, Agent Services maintain policy and trajectories, and Environment Services own sandbox state. An orchestration plane connects them by task phase and supports fine-grained concurrency and heterogeneous configurations.

key_results.zh: 在实际 Agent 训练部署中，MegaFlow 被报告可稳定编排数万并发任务并保持较高资源利用率，填补复杂 Agent 负载的开放基础设施缺口。
key_results.en: In agent-training deployments, MegaFlow is reported to orchestrate tens of thousands of concurrent tasks with high stability and efficient resource utilization.

limitations.zh: 摘要未说明三服务间一致性、环境快照恢复或跨地域网络成本，数万任务的结果也来自特定训练部署，外部硬件与环境类型上的复现仍待验证。
limitations.en: The abstract does not detail cross-service consistency, environment snapshot recovery, or multi-region network cost; tens-of-thousands scale is shown in specific deployments and remains to be reproduced across other hardware and environments.

hardware: distributed model, agent, and environment services
evaluation.cluster_scale: tens of thousands of concurrent agent tasks

notes.zh: 任务类型、三服务部署和数万并发规模来自官方摘要；模型、GPU/环境数量、利用率与稳定性指标待全文审计。
notes.en: Task types, three-service deployment, and tens-of-thousands concurrency come from the official abstract; models, GPU/environment counts, utilization, and stability metrics await full-text audit.
